concerns.text: The specification’s Success Criteria (SC‑001‑SC‑007) list only tables and numeric summaries; the original idea explicitly calls for visualizations (volcano plots, CLR‑based ordination) in the “Output generation” section. No requirement or test case for generating these figures is present, constituting an under‑reach of the idea’s deliverables.

FR‑012 introduces an a‑priori power analysis (detect β = 0.1 with 80 % power) and associated warning/halt logic. The idea’s methodology sketch never mentions a power analysis; this adds a new analytical step that was not requested, representing an over‑reach beyond the original research question.
